answer: Embodied liveness residency: each identity must sustain a continuous power draw and thermal signature from a physical device the operator runs, reported through hardware attestation. A single operator cannot fake an ember of real heat across many units without buying many units. An echo of past attestations is rejected; leases expire hourly. Encrypted reports arrive on a velvet-smooth schedule that tolerates jitter but not absence. Cost: one device, one power line, and one thermal budget per identity, so faking N identities requires N physical machines.
